g:HTMLPanel.p: Labels, text inputs, selects and help text, laid out in rows, columns or a horizontal form.

d:Example.heading: Form controls
d:Example.description: A `FormLabel` linked to its control with `for`, and a `HelpBlock` under it. Wrap each pair in a `FormGroup` with a margin.

d:Example.heading: Horizontal form
d:Example.description: Put each label and control in a `FormRow` with column classes to line them up.

d:Example.heading: Sizing
d:Example.description: `size` on a text control makes it larger or smaller.

d:Example.heading: Disabled and read-only
d:Example.description: `enabled="false"` on a `FieldSet` disables every control in it; `FormControlStatic` shows a value as plain text.
